_readme: swarmArena cron schedule templates. register_crons.py replaces every /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/swarm-arena placeholder with the real skill root and writes register_crons.json plus ready-to-paste crontab lines. Times are in the system local timezone of the host crontab; daily_summary is intended for 00:00 UTC — set TZ=UTC in crontab or adjust the schedule.

jobs.name: scan
jobs.description: Main trading cycle: validate config, honor halt/circuit-breaker, reset daily counters, reconcile positions, run trade_loop for each allowed symbol, trail stops, persist state, run review every 5 new trades.

alternate_schedules._comment: Paper mode is read-only; a 5-minute cadence is plenty and kinder to the public API.

jobs.name: review
jobs.description: Learning loop: resolve open trade outcomes, recompute stats, apply bounded adaptations to state.metrics.

jobs.name: daily-summary
jobs.description: Midnight UTC digest: full status plus 24h review summary.

jobs.name: halt-check
jobs.description: Watchdog: alerts (exit 1) when halted, circuit breaker tripped, 3+ consecutive errors, or daily loss >= 80% of the limit.
jobs.command: /usr/bin/env python3 /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/swarm-arena/scripts/status.py /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/swarm-arena/config.json --json | /usr/bin/env python3 -c "import sys,json; s=json.load(sys.stdin); bad = s.get('halt') or s.get('circuit_breaker') or s.get('consecutive_errors',0) >= 3 or (s.get('limits',{}).get('max_daily_loss',0) > 0 and s.get('daily_loss',0) >= 0.8 * s['limits']['max_daily_loss']); print('ALERT' if bad else 'OK', json.dumps({'halt': s.get('halt'), 'circuit_breaker': s.get('circuit_breaker'), 'consecutive_errors': s.get('consecutive_errors'), 'daily_loss': s.get('daily_loss')})); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)" >> /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/swarm-arena/logs/watchdog.log 2>&1
